test_title: PYST 18: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

I have read that /a Leaning Tower of Pisa is a / popular tourist attraction / in the world.

options.text: a Leaning Tower of Pisa is a

solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"a Leaning Tower of Pisa is a."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error lies in the part "a Leaning Tower of Pisais a ."<
